questions.question: The Indian Space Research Organisation (ISRO) was formed in August ________.
Which Chalukyan king shifted the capital from Manyakheta to Kalyani?
As per Census 2011, what was the sex ratio of Kerala?
In May 2025, tiny plastic pellets, known as nurdles, were found on beaches in Thiruvananthapuram, Kerala, following the sinking of a container vessel. What are nurdles?
options: Tiny recycled glass beads used for road marking and decoration
Compressed wooden pellets used for furniture and panel making
Small pre-formed plastic pellets used for moulding and extrusion
Natural clay balls shaped for pottery and ceramic production
questions.explanation: सही उत्तर विकल्प 'C' (Small pre-formed plastic pellets used for moulding and extrusion) है।

questions.question: Which Part of the Indian Constitution deals with Fundamental Duties?
Who among the following is NOT a Cabinet Minister?
questions.explanation: सही उत्तर विकल्प 'A' (Dr. Chandra Sekhar Pemmasani) है।

questions.question: Who is the author of the book 'The Argumentative Indian', which explores India's cultural history and diversity?
The Administrator of Dadra and Nagar Haveli is concurrently the Administrator of which Union Territory?
questions.explanation: सही उत्तर विकल्प 'B' (Daman and Diu) है।

questions.question: Udham Singh assassinated a British official in London in 1940. Who among the following was this official and for which of the following reasons was he targeted?
options: Michael O'Dwyer - As revenge for his role in the Jallianwala Bagh massacre
Jack Gibson - A British officer unrelated to the Jallianwala Bagh massacre
Lord Zetland - Secretary of State for India, targeted for supporting colonial repression
Charles Innes - Former Viceroy of India, targeted for unrelated colonial policies
questions.explanation: सही उत्तर विकल्प 'A' (Michael O'Dwyer - As revenge for his role in the Jallianwala Bagh massacre) है।

questions.question: Agar is obtained from ______________.
To propagate Indian Dance and Music, the erstwhile government of united Andhra Pradesh started Sri Thyagaraja Government college of Music and Dance in the year 1952 at _________.
Which of the following is NOT a function of money in an economy?
questions.explanation: सही उत्तर विकल्प 'B' (Unit of labour) है।

questions.question: In 2025, the NGT sought responses over large-scale felling of palm trees in Bihar. To which plant family do palm trees belong?
options: Family Fabaceae of leguminous flowering plants in India
Family Moraceae of tropical flowering plants in India
Family Pinaceae of coniferous evergreen plants in India
Family Arecaceae of monocotyledonous flowering plants
questions.explanation: सही उत्तर विकल्प 'D' (Family Arecaceae of monocotyledonous flowering plants) है।

questions.question: Transverse nature of light causes:
questions.explanation: सही उत्तर विकल्प 'A' (polarisation of light) है।

questions.question: Who among the following received the Col. CK Nayudu Lifetime Achievement Award for Men at the BCCI Awards in 2025?
When did the first independent ruler Qutubud-din-Aibak establish the Slave dynasty?
By which Constitutional Amendment Act were the territories of Goa, Daman, and Diu incorporated into the Indian Constitution?
questions.explanation: सही उत्तर विकल्प 'D' (12th Amendment Act, 1962) है।

questions.question: निम्नलिखित में से किसे भारत के पूर्व-पुरापाषाण युग का औज़ार नहीं माना जाता है?
Our body converts β-carotene into _____.
9 : 3 : 3 : 1 लक्षणप्ररूपी अनुपात (phenotypic ratio),  __________ है।
options: द्विसंकर क्रॉस के लिए चिरसम्मत मेंडलीय अनुपात
एकसंकर क्रॉस के लिए चिरसम्मत मेंडलीय अनुपात
एकसंकर क्रॉस के लिए गैर-मेंडलीय अनुपात
त्रिसंकर क्रॉस के लिए मेंडलीय अनुपात
questions.explanation: सही उत्तर विकल्प 'A' (द्विसंकर क्रॉस के लिए चिरसम्मत मेंडलीय अनुपात) है।
